_doc: Exempts specific blockers in committed, frozen patches (never edited to satisfy critics) for tests/test_integration_patches.py::test_review_patch_no_blockers ONLY. Until Q3 (quick 261012-di7, 2026-10-12) this file held 120 entries described as pre-existing 'debt'; most were critic false positives -- display-only sinks, preset membership cords, fan-outs whose branches never reconverge at different inlets, and Bach command messages. 51 were already stale and one named a deleted file. Q3 removed them when the critics stopped emitting them. Remaining entries are true positives and each must carry a `reason`. Matching keys: fanout = source_id + outlet; bach_llll = source_id + inlet + sorted destinations. New patches and new blockers are never exempted. test_review_allowlist_entries_are_live fails on stale entries, missing files and missing reasons. Calibration-project (user-confirmed) patches must not appear here; they must review with zero blockers.

patches/rhythmic-sampler/generated/slot..reason: True positive (fix-plan rule 3), surfaced by Q3 (quick 261012-di7) once signal-ness was read from outlettype instead of the `~` name: `buffer~ #1` obj-1 outlet 1 (bang after read) feeds `setbuffer #1` obj-27, which reaches waveform~ obj-4 inlets 2/3 via js slot-engine.js -> `t f f` -> expr -> `trigger f f`, and `set #1` obj-28, which reaches waveform~ obj-4 inlet 0. It works in MAX because fan-out fires right-to-left by box position (setbuffer at x=300 before set at x=110). The patch is frozen (never edited to satisfy critics); listed in the Q3 SUMMARY.
